name: Shinano (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Shinano town emblem in white: a disc bearing the character 信 in light blue.
history: Municipal flag of Shinano, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Shinano town emblem — a disc bearing the character 信 in light blue
